raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 10, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely chose Peter Bjorn and John as the “performer” of “Falling Out,” incorrectly citing them as the earliest album (stating 2002 when Serena Ryder’s 1999 album exists) and treating a band’s origin as a performer’s birthplace. This ignored proper disambiguation (e.g., Serena Ryder as a singular performer) and led to the wrong birthplace and castle (Stockholm Palace instead of a likely answer such as Casa Loma in Toronto).
